sv.title: Här praoar prinsessan Estelle hos Alexander Stubb
sv.summary: Förra veckan praoade prinsessan Estelle, 14, hos sin morfar, kungen. Nu fortsätter hon hos Finlands president Alexander Stubb. ”Kul och lärorikt”, sa prinsessan om första praoveckan.

en.title: Princess Estelle does work experience with Alexander Stubb
en.summary: Last week Princess Estelle, 14, did work experience with her maternal grandfather, the King. Now she continues with Finnish President Alexander Stubb. "Fun and educational," the princess said about her first work-experience week.
